title: New settings page, easier to use, with new background colors
summary: Courier settings are redesigned: workspace pages in one section, developer pages in another, light and dark themes, and nine background colors to choose from.
body_markdown:
*Part of the ongoing redesign of the Courier app.*


Settings has been redesigned. It opens over your work, and the pages inside are grouped by what they're for: **Workspace** for your account, and **Developers** for the keys, webhooks, and limits behind your sends.


*The new look, on the Webhooks page.*


## Workspace


- **General.** Name the workspace and set how the app looks while you work in it.
- **Team.** Invite the people who need access, and remove them when they move on.
- **Billing.** See your plan and how much of it you've used.
- **AI Credits.** Check what's left of the credits behind Courier's AI features.
- **Audit Trail.** See who changed a template, a provider, or a setting, and when.


## Developers


- **API Keys.** Grab the key your code authenticates with, scoped to the environment you're in.
- **Webhooks.** Push Courier's delivery events to your systems with[outbound webhooks](https://www.courier.com/docs/platform/workspaces/outbound-webhooks) , or get a URL another system can call to start a send with[inbound webhooks](https://www.courier.com/docs/platform/workspaces/inbound-webhooks) .
- **Tracking.** Turn click-through and email-open tracking on when you want engagement data.
- **Send Limits.** Cap what the workspace can send so a bug can't reach your users thousands of times.
- **Tenants.** Set how Courier decides which tenant a user belongs to.


## Light, dark, and nine background colors


Under General, **Theme** switches the app between Light, Dark, and System. Below it, **Background color** sets the tint the app sits on.


*Nine background colors. Sunset is the default, and the other eight are one click away.*


Sunset, the warm orange gradient, is the default and the first swatch. The other eight run through pink, green, blue, purple, teal, near-black, and warm gray. Pick one and it carries across the app.


## Take a look


Open[settings](https://app.courier.com/settings/general) and the new layout is already there. More of the app is getting the same treatment, so watch the[changelog](https://www.courier.com/changelog) as the rest lands.
